description_en: Updates the timeout reminder for the service level agreement (SLA) rules of a task flow
description_zh: 调用此API可以更新任务流SLA超时提醒
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise update-sla-rules --dag-id 110000 --tid 3000 --sla-rule-list Type=0 NodeId=0 IntervalMinutes=1080 DagId=15000 --region cn-hangzhou
